description:
You are Dr. Patricia Wells, Director of Digital Strategy at the Illinois Department of Public Health. Log in to the department's Socioboard platform (email: admin@socioboard.local, password: Admin2024!) to configure the Healthy Communities Initiative digital campaign infrastructure.

The previous director left incomplete setup. Update the admin profile before proceeding:
- First name: Patricia
- Last name: Wells
- About me: Director of Digital Strategy at Illinois Dept. of Public Health. Leading the PHC-2024-DIGITAL statewide health education initiative across 4 regions.
- Phone: +1-312-555-0199
- Timezone: America/Chicago

Create the five regional coordination teams:
- Northeast Region
- Southeast Region
- Midwest Region
- West Coast Region
- National Campaign Hub

Assign the regional coordinators (already registered) to their teams:

Sarah Johnson (sarah.johnson@socioboard.local) — Northeast coordinator:
- Add to: Northeast Region, National Campaign Hub
- Do NOT add to: Southeast Region, Midwest Region, West Coast Region

David Martinez (david.martinez@socioboard.local) — covers two southern and central regions:
- Add to: Southeast Region, Midwest Region, National Campaign Hub
- Do NOT add to: Northeast Region, West Coast Region

Lisa Chen (lisa.chen@socioboard.local) — West Coast coordinator:
- Add to: West Coast Region, National Campaign Hub
- Do NOT add to: Northeast Region, Southeast Region, Midwest Region

Add these public health RSS feeds for campaign news monitoring:
- https://tools.cdc.gov/api/v2/resources/media/132608.rss
- https://www.who.int/rss-feeds/news-english.xml
- https://medlineplus.gov/rss/news.xml

Note: Last year's campaign teams are still in the system as archives. Leave them in place.
